web-guide-idea-45.audience: Creators whose profiles do not clearly explain their offer.
web-guide-idea-45.offer: Help the person make their bio, examples and presentation easier to understand. Keep feedback tied to their intended audience.
web-guide-idea-45.steps.0: Ask who the creator wants to reach.
web-guide-idea-45.steps.1: Review the bio and a few sample posts.
web-guide-idea-45.steps.2: Rewrite the core offer together and choose the next improvements.
web-guide-idea-45.equipment: A phone is enough to review a profile; a laptop can make note-taking easier.
web-guide-idea-45.returnReason: Review the updated profile after the creator has tried a clearer direction.
web-guide-idea-45.promotion: Show a fictional profile rewrite. Avoid promising follower counts or algorithmic reach.
